gloss: hundreds; several hundred; how many hundreds

definitions.explanation: An indefinite expression for an unspecified number in the hundreds. Typically used with も to emphasize how many there are.

examples.japanese: {何百|なんびゃく}{人|にん}も{集|あつ}まった。
{何百|なんびゃく}{年|ねん}も{前|まえ}の{建物|たてもの}だ。
examples.english: It's a building from hundreds of years ago.

examples.japanese: この{図書館|としょかん}には{何百|なんびゃく}{冊|さつ}もの{古|ふる}い{本|ほん}が{保管|ほかん}されている。
examples.english: Hundreds of old books are kept in this library.

notes:
Combines {何|なに}/{何|なん} (how many; what) + {百|ひゃく} (hundred). The {百|ひゃく} voices to びゃく after {何|なん}. Almost always appears with a counter and the particle も to mean "hundreds of..."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何百|なんびゃく}{人|にん}も: hundreds of people
- {何百|なんびゃく}{年|ねん}も{前|まえ}: hundreds of years ago
- {何百|なんびゃく}{回|かい}も: hundreds of times
- {何百|なんびゃく}{冊|さつ}も: hundreds of (books)
- {何百|なんびゃく}{万円|まんえん}: several million yen (lit. "hundreds of ten-thousand yen")

QUESTION USE:
Without も, {何百|なんびゃく}〜? can also ask "how many hundreds?": {何百|なんびゃく}{人|にん}{来|き}たの？ — "How many hundreds of people came?" — but the "hundreds of" reading is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何千|なんぜん}: thousands of
- {何万|なんまん}: tens of thousands of
- {何十|なんじゅう}: tens of, dozens of
